description.value: Buddha-Full is a fully plant-based, organic, gluten-free cafe and juice bar on the Lonsdale waterfront in North Vancouver, with a retail provisions store alongside. The menu spans smoothies, cold-pressed juices, entrees, salads, and catering, with all items vegan and gluten-free by default. It is one of two Vancouver-area locations (West 1st and Northwoods) and has attracted regional press attention for its whole-food ethos.
